description: Single source of the circuit domain tags and circuit constants. Each tag value is the big-endian integer of the ASCII text bytes. The text is at most 27 bytes, so value * 2^32 + 31 is less than the BN254 scalar field modulus. Rust, TypeScript, and Noir copy these values; their tests compare them with this file.

tags.name: commitment
tags.use: c = H(DOM_COMMITMENT, deployment_id_hi, deployment_id_lo, k_hi, k_lo)

tags.name: batch_id
tags.use: batch_id = H(DOM_BATCH_ID, deployment_id_hi, deployment_id_lo, k_hi, k_lo)

tags.name: binding
tags.use: binding = H(DOM_BINDING, gateway_id_hi, gateway_id_lo, session_pub_hi, session_pub_lo)

tags.name: mmr_node
tags.use: node = H(DOM_MMR_NODE * 2^32 + height, left, right); height is the parent height

tags.name: mmr_root
tags.use: root = H(DOM_MMR_ROOT, leaf_count, slot[31], slot[30], ..., slot[0])

circuit_id.use: First public input of the batch-open circuit. It names protocol version 1 and the circuit statement.
